h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panipat

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panipat

c: Panipat weaves a large share of India's blankets, durries and home furnishings, and its textile units run long shifts on the looms and in the dyeing sheds. The refinery township outside the city adds a second large group of workers and their families. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Panipat to these factory compounds and townships, and to schools, colleges, housing sectors and ward parks.

Every Fun Fitness machine is built at our Vasai factory, about 1190 km south of Panipat, and travels up by road. A north India dealer or our own installers put it in place. Haryana summers are hot and dusty, the monsoon is short and winter mornings are cold and foggy along the GT Road belt. Galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded seats suit this mix, and dust is the main thing to watch for on moving parts.

items.q: Can a textile factory in Panipat install an outdoor gym for its staff?
items.a: Yes. Send us the free area inside the compound, a few photos and the number of workers per shift. We suggest machines that suit them and send a layout drawing with a quote.

items.q: How do we keep dust out of the moving parts?
items.a: Wipe the handles and pivots every week in the dry months and check the bolts before and after summer. Grease the bearings as per the care sheet we share at handover.

items.q: Are the machines usable on foggy winter mornings?
items.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and do not mind damp air. Handles can be wet with dew, so users should wipe them first and take care on the footplates.
